name: Nvim development (prerelease) build
body:
```
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1944+g7b87ce822e
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1792527110
```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/7b87ce822e6fd45a4d9993599c2854afdb0dc4dd) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v1.4.239
body:
**Two releases today!** Check out the [v1.4.238 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.238) too. That release brought shared unsaved edits across workspaces, richer agent chats and remote account setup, a more capable browser, and smoother phone controls.

## Your workspace, working together 🐳

Set up agent skills in one click, keep browser sessions separate between projects, and move more easily between chat and terminal. This release also strengthens the essentials: shared files stay in sync, SSH sessions recover more reliably, and phone interactions feel more predictable.

## The short version

- **Skills, ready wherever you work:** Install Orca’s skills in one click from setup screens, and install or update them on paired servers and SSH hosts with Orca’s own installer.
- **A browser that fits your projects:** Choose shared, per-repo or per-workspace profiles for new tabs. Keep local app logins separate, use a familiar page context menu, and get clearer explanations when a page cannot load.
- **More fluid agent conversations:** Split into a fresh chat beside your current one, continue with a terminal agent from the pane header, and keep queued messages and multiple image attachments intact.
- **Safer edits, quieter background work:** Shared file views stay current after undo and discard. Non-UTF-8 files ask before conversion, file watching recovers after slowdowns, and Orca watches fewer unrelated files.
- **Remote work with a way back:** Recover supported managed SSH servers from a stale lock in Settings, restore terminals after password sign-in, and keep a paired server’s SSH access link through restarts.
- **Better from your phone:** Tapping a notification opens the agent that sent it, agent chat tabs can start dictation, terminal copy commands reach the phone clipboard, and Android scrolling keeps the keyboard out of the way.
- **Everyday polish, across languages:** Better Korean input, Bengali and other Indic terminal rendering, more complete translations, Jira user pickers, and PR comment links that jump straight to the editor.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone updates the served interface. Native download, progress and navigation improvements require an updated native phone app.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Browser profiles:** Choose **Settings → Browser → Profile for new tabs**. **Shared** remains the default; per-repo and per-workspace profiles apply to new tabs. Paired-server pages use the server’s own profiles.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca for the latest chat and launch fixes. Chat availability now checks the chat runtime separately from the terminal CLI, including supported Antigravity setups.
- **SSH recovery:** **Recover server…** is available for supported managed Linux SSH hosts reporting a stale-lock refusal. It checks the lock and asks you to confirm that no other machine sharing that home is running Orca before clearing it. Phones point you to desktop Settings.
- **Experimental groundwork:** Connector work remains behind the off-by-default `experimentalConnectors` flag. The layout-owner groundwork remains disabled. The empty-group launch actions and child-workspace status toggle were reverted before release.

---

## Product experience

### Agents, skills & setup

*Get agent skills onto the machines where you work, with clearer launch choices and startup feedback.*

* Update Orca's skills with Orca's own installer instead of npx skills by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31688
* Install and update Orca's skills on paired servers and SSH hosts by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31867
* Install Orca's skills with one click on every setup screen by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31918
* Chat agents are offered wherever their chat program runs, not only where their CLI is installed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28709
* Explain agent startup failures in plain words by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31932
* Agents: store each agent's permission itself; terminals and new chats read it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31315
* Apply paired host preferences to launch menus by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31971
* fix(agents): + quick launch on a paired host uses the desktop's launch settings by @StrangerG in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32050
* Negotiate agent launches with paired runtimes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32029
* Pair structured launches with the CLI runtime by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32061
* Keep agent environment values with spaces when the field loses focus by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31772
* Retain managed WSL selection across distro casing by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31992
* Allow independent hidden account restarts to progress by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31994
* Start the default agent in the first folder added after skipping onboarding by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32701
* Read Cursor Unified Ultra current-period quotas by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31978
* Show OpenCode provider quota failures as usage limits by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31937
* Keep Claude weekly usage from jumping back to an idle session’s old value by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32249
* Refine Agent Dashboard lifecycle handling by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32172
* Respect completed setup when CLI registration is unavailable by @spf13 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32085

### Native chat (experimental)

*Keep conversations moving, split off a fresh chat, and reach pane actions without leaving the conversation.*

* Split into a fresh chat beside the current conversation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28950
* Add terminal-style pane header actions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28968
* Send pi and acp messages after a model-only change by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32004
* A missing claude or codex cli no longer stalls the model picker on every open by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32014
* Keep every image chip when several images are dropped at once by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32022
* Show spelling suggestions when right-clicking chat inputs by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32035
* Continue the chat when a background subagent wakes an idle parent by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31778
* Retain unlisted reported Codex models by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32068
* Keep queued messages in the chat's own record, so a refused one can't be skipped by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30418
* Allow inline visuals to declare open by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32226
* Preserve accepted command outcomes across agent startup by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31605
* A nested claude -p no longer takes over its parent pane's status by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31780
* Keep a finished turn done when the agent reports an approval at idle by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32015
* Show task names for Codex subagents by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32243

### Browser

*Separate project sessions, open links where you expect them, and get clearer page controls and recovery.*

* Per-repo or per-workspace browser profile for new tabs by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32039
* feat(browser): Chrome-style page context menu and DevTools window shortcuts by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31821
* Say why a page failed to load and reload it when it can by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31847
* Open links beside their pane, focus link tabs, honor window.close() by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31844
* Markup controls sit below the page in a mobile viewport instead of covering it by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32019
* Remove browser tab favicon drop shadows by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32143
* Open local html file links in the browser link routing picks by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32706
* Remote tunnel matches Chromium for IPv6 bypass rules and <-loopback> by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32665

### Phone

*Reach the right agent, dictate from chat, and keep terminal gestures and clipboard actions predictable.*

* Tapping a phone push opens the agent that sent it by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31773
* Start dictation from agent chat tabs by @pelted in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32105
* Keep the android keyboard closed when you scroll or swipe the terminal by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32038
* Send multi-line chat messages as one bracketed paste by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31776
* Copy OSC 52 terminal writes, like Claude Code's /btw copy, to the phone clipboard by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32042
* Decode page-bundle download windows natively by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31817
* Download only the page assets the cached generation lacks by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31769
* One download bar whose fill follows progress on the native driver by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31755
* The shell returns to a screen already on its stack by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32110
* Finish bundle downloads over slow links with smaller ranges by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32174
* Keep a terminal tab's chat identity while its handle is unchanged by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32251
* Add Copy path beside Copy in mobile Markdown footer by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32748
* Improve contrast of mobile Markdown copy buttons by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32844
* Keep mobile agent icons visible on retained routes by @zhangxaochen in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31948

### Editor, files & performance

*Keep every view of a file current and reduce unnecessary background work.*

* Every view of a shared file stays current after undo or discard, and non-UTF-8 files ask before converting by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32413

* File watching rides out a slow system instead of restarting, and turns itself back on after a cooldown by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32397

### Terminals, SSH & remote servers

*Recover interrupted remote work and keep terminal output, file links and workspace lifecycle actions dependable.*

* feat(ssh): Recover server for a managed host refused on a stale lock, and surface that refusal in seconds by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32951

### Projects, source control & integrations

*Jump from reviews to code, fill Jira user fields, and keep project actions tied to the right work.*

### Language, accessibility & interface polish

*More natural text input, clearer translations, and controls that work better with touch and assistive tools.*

name: v1.4.238
body:
## More connected work, safer edits 🐳

This release makes it easier to move between agents, files, browsers and remote machines. Tabs of the same file now share unsaved edits, native chats pick up turns made elsewhere, and the phone gets more dependable terminal gestures and richer tab controls.

## The short version

- **Your edits stay together:** Tabs of the same file share unsaved text across workspaces. Conflict review sees that live text, workspace deletion lists unsaved files, and stale Markdown or notebook edits no longer overwrite newer work.
- **Chats that keep up:** Codex and Pi show turns made outside the chat. Long pastes can become text attachments, Codex questions get answer cards, and OMP gains image sending and actionable plan-review cards.
- **More control over agents:** Pick chat or terminal when creating a workspace, set that choice for your default agent, add Claude and Codex accounts on supported remote servers, and install shared skills for 11 more agents.
- **A more capable browser:** A workspace-aware new tab, address-bar suggestions, remembered site permissions, per-site appearance and zoom, and page-loading progress on desktop and phone.
- **A smoother phone experience:** See agent activity in tabs, rename with a double-tap, scroll back through earlier chat messages, select terminal text more naturally, and return to your terminal reading position after resuming.
- **Better visibility and recovery:** Inspect local terminals in Resource Manager, use plain SSH when a host’s move to an Orca server is blocked, and keep pairings through managed-server updates and recovery.
- **Everyday polish:** Brazilian Portuguese, language selection during onboarding, searchable release builds, clearer history-scan progress, and **Resolve with AI** for paused merges, rebases and cherry-picks—even after file conflicts are fixed.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone updates the served interface. The new **Home → New Workspace** entry and native iOS dictation fixes require an updated native phone app; the home-screen entry ships with the next app build.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Remote accounts:** Update the paired server for the new Claude and Codex Add Account flow. Windows servers and older hosts retain the `orca account add` guidance. Credentials stay on the server; remote re-authentication of an existing account is outside this change.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca for the latest chat fixes. Agent version checks now accept newer releases and prereleases that meet the required minimum; a known older version shows update guidance.
- **Resource Manager:** The new PTYs view covers local terminals. Ending a terminal requires host support for verifying the selected session; older hosts refuse unchecked termination.
- **HTML files:** Opening HTML in preview by default was reverted for this release.
- **Experimental groundwork:** Layout-owner and sidebar changes listed below remain disabled. Connector configuration is off by default, and the new optional agent-write controls have no existing callers enabled.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Continue conversations across chat and terminal, answer agent questions, and share images and long prompts more easily.*

* Show turns made outside Orca in an existing Codex chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30883
* Show turns made outside Orca in an existing Pi chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31618
* Attach long pastes as text files and flag oversized messages before sending by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30398
* Codex async questions show an answer card on desktop and phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31652
* OMP's plan review shows as a plan card you can answer from desktop and mobile chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31635
* Questions over 16 KB show their card with every option by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31632
* OMP chats send images; an ACP agent's own startup answer decides by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30910
* Keep newer agent versions and eligible prereleases available for chat, with clear guidance when an installed version is too old by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30393
* Keep model choices coherent across Claude updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30107
* Typing fast after focus moves keeps keys in order by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31203
* Retire ghost queued continuation bubbles by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31479
* Show a prompt hook's block as its own row for every agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30898
* A cancelled approval card closes even when the journal was briefly full by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31735
* Open inline images directly in preview dialog by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31620
* Handle inline image preview edge cases by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31742
* Set minimum width for native chat table cells by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31848
* Gate draft image ownership checks by local attachments by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32098
* Avoid repeated skill catalog scans while building the picker by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31936

### Agents, accounts & skills

*Choose chat or terminal when starting work, add accounts on a remote server, and install shared skills for more agents.*

* Choose chat or terminal CLI in Create worktree, Create folder and continuation pickers by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31189
* Set the default agent to open as a chat or a terminal CLI by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31590
* Add Claude and Codex accounts on supported remote servers from a paired desktop by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31461
* Restart WSL Claude panes after an account switch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31945
* Install shared skills for 11 more agents and stop Qoder listing skills twice by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31657
* Preserve Cursor identity across imported Claude hooks by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31469
* Renaming a terminal no longer hides its running agent by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31428
* Route OMP question cards to terminal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31440

### Phone: tabs, chat & workspaces

*Read earlier messages without losing your place, see agent activity in the tab strip, and keep workspace actions on the right computer.*

* Tab strip shows terminal and chat agent state, reveals the next tab, renames on double-tap by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31372

* Phone terminal and chat tab names match the desktop by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31384
* Closing the tab a phone shows returns it to the tab it viewed before by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31365
* Keep closed terminal tabs from reappearing after quick closes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31711
* New Tab drawer reopens with its agents and refreshes them when desktop does by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31367
* Keep a Codex chat on screen when Codex shows its idle title on a headless host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31460
* Floating-panel chats started from a phone show on the desktop by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31364
* Mobile chat composer uses desktop's placeholder by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31425
* Attach Codex images when agent identity is missing by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31370
* Refresh chat file suggestions when the desktop connection changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31702
* Load the right agent history when you switch computers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31695
* Prepare Home’s New Workspace drawer; the home-screen entry requires the next native phone app build by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31305
* Open Create Workspace after source drawer closes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31488
* Detect New Workspace agents in the selected repo runtime by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31351
* Load folder workspace agent presets on the correct host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31442
* Keep your setup-script choice when the repository list refreshes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31694
* Warn about agents that cannot wake on a windowless server only when the workspace has sleeping agents by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31607
* Recover workspace features after temporary connection checks fail by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31480
* Keep selected mobile options visible while locked by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31628
* Announce locked picker notice on iOS by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31674

### Phone: terminals, voice & touch

*Select text more naturally, return to the same reading position, and keep scrolling, dictation and keyboard input dependable.*

* Drag terminal selection with the long-press finger by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31433
* Select Unicode words at rendered cell boundaries by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31434
* Keep terminal scroll gestures from becoming taps by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31445
* Preserve prompt taps after terminal scrolling by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31471
* Start phone terminal scrolling without a timer delay by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31472
* Retain terminal reading position after resume by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31661
* Prevent stale terminal sizing and stream callbacks from affecting a newer phone session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31432
* Clear old touch gestures before replaying a terminal snapshot by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31437
* Cancel stale shortcut list drags by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31436

name: v2026.1023.0
body:
# Paperclip v2026.1023.0

> Released: 2026-10-23

Paperclip v2026.1023.0 carries 200 commits, promoted from `2026.1012.1-beta.0`. The headline is private work: a task or project can now be marked private and shared with named people and agents; everyone else cannot open it, find it in task lists or search, read its run transcripts, or reach it through a plugin. Around that: agents can run through your own model gateway (OpenRouter, Amazon Bedrock, Google Gemini, or any OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, or Chat Completions endpoint), Slack bots set themselves up through Slack's Manifest API, the GitHub review bot gets a two-screen setup and a real **Paperclip Review** status check, Costs becomes an exact ledger that also shows monthly subscription fees, and connected assistants can edit tasks, upload files, and configure agents over MCP. Underneath, OpenAI Dot and Pi 1.0 join the experimental Runner, native OpenCode streams as it types, each agent gets a persistent cryptographic identity, and idle instances stop polling the database every second.

## Breaking Changes

- **Operators can now edit the company.** The Operator role preset grows from one grant (`tasks:assign`) to fourteen: agent creation and configuration, skills, environments, invitations, task assignment, pipelines, connections, tool management and use, and audit reads. Existing Operators pick up the missing grants through the normal startup seeding; custom grant scopes are kept. Join approval and member-permission management stay out of the preset, and inviting an Admin now requires join approval while inviting an Owner also requires member-permission management. Review your member roles if Operators were meant to be read-mostly. ([#15377](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15377))
- **GitHub review bots move behind their own experimental setting.** The **GitHub Code Review Bot** catalog entry, its setup, and its management screens appear only while **Settings → Experimental → GitHub review bots** (`enableGitHubReviewBots`, off by default) is on; existing bots keep running while it is off. The old setup-method and delegated-agent screens are gone, and per-person automatic-run flags are replaced by author include/exclude filters (legacy `people[].automaticReviews` values are read but ignored). ([#15416](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15416))
- **Budgets hold on unpriced usage by default.** Each budget policy gains an unpriced-usage setting that defaults to `block`: while a run's usage has no reliable price, the policy counts as at its limit until the charge is resolved through the audited cost adjustment flow. Set the policy to `allow` to keep running on unpriced usage. ([#14997](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14997))

## Highlights

- **Private tasks and projects** — Mark a task private when you create it, or make a project private with its own member list; a personal private project is created for you on first use. Private work is readable only by its responsible user, creator, current assignee, named grantees, and private-project members, and that rule applies to task lists and task counts, search, activity, run detail, transcripts, events, and logs, documents, attachments, work products, and every plugin read. Two surfaces stay company-wide on purpose: dashboard and sidebar totals may count private work without exposing a title or identifier, and the company run list shows a locked row for a private task's run with only the agent, status, timing, token, and cost fields, so budget oversight keeps working. Privacy flows down to children; sharing a child never exposes its parent or siblings. Owners and admins do not see private tasks by default and must request `?breakGlass=true`, which writes an audit row and a warning notice on the task. Agents' access is intersected with the run's responsible user, so reusing an agent does not carry another person's permissions. ([#14717](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14717), [#10633](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/10633), [#14718](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14718))
- **Bring your own model gateway** — Connectors gains rows for OpenRouter, Amazon Bedrock, Google Gemini, and generic Responses API, Messages API, Chat Completions API, and local endpoints. URLs, protocol, region, and credentials live on the connection; the agent's Harness / Runtime page picks a compatible **Connection** from a dropdown and the model picker accepts manual IDs. Codex (legacy and Runner) routes to OpenRouter or custom Responses endpoints, Claude (legacy and Runner) to OpenRouter, custom Messages endpoints, or Bedrock, and OpenCode and Hermes to OpenRouter or custom Chat Completions endpoints. OpenRouter connections without an explicit model list load OpenRouter's public catalog. ([#14970](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14970), [#15341](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15341))
- **Slack bots set themselves up** — New Slack bot drafts default to automatic setup: paste a temporary App configuration token, Paperclip creates the app through Slack's Manifest API, installs it through OAuth, links your Slack account, uploads the agent's avatar, and verifies delivery in a four-screen wizard with no Slack CLI involved ([#15413](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15413)). A new **Require at-mention** setting stops thread replies from waking the agent without an explicit mention ([#15612](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15612)); a follow-up sent after a Slack Stop starts a fresh turn instead of stalling ([#15737](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15737)); and Slack agents now know the saved slash command people use to link their accounts, link every task they create, and report results and review requests back in the originating thread ([#15576](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15576), [#15579](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15579), [#15611](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15611)).
- **A two-screen GitHub review bot** — Setup is now Choose agent, then Connect GitHub under a personal account or organization; GitHub asks for creation and installation consent, and Paperclip stores the App secrets locally, imports repository access, and verifies delivery. Each accepted request gets one editable App-owned progress comment, and review assessments publish a **Paperclip Review** check for the reviewed commit with a configurable passing score (1–5) that branch protection can require. A self-hosted instance needs one Paperclip Cloud approval before its first managed GitHub connection, because Cloud hosts the fixed OAuth callback and signed webhook inbox; tokens are sealed to your instance. ([#15416](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15416))
- **Costs you can reconcile** — Accounting is now a durable, exact ledger: usage receipts are fsynced and replayed after failures, retries settle one charge, amounts keep decimal cents, and every event is marked reported, estimated, or unpriced instead of silently zero ([#14991](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14991), [#14997](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14997)). The Costs page reports each connected ChatGPT or Claude subscription's monthly fee once beside API spend, lets you enter the real price, and keeps ambiguous plans unpriced ([#15634](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15634)); quota reads are scoped to authorized company accounts ([#14994](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14994)); cost gaps are listed by agent with links to the affected runs, the model the runtime actually selected is recorded, and a retry appears only when saved evidence is ready ([#15948](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15948)); and historical pricing gaps show as a neutral note under the totals rather than a red error ([#15459](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15459)).
- **Assistants that can do more over MCP** — A connected Claude Code, Codex, or other MCP assistant can now edit tasks, finish or block them, write documents and revisions, register deliverables, upload files through expiring tickets, and, with a separately consented configuration scope, manage agent settings and instructions, projects and repositories, and skills ([#15380](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15380)). Connections are named by owner and client ("Dotta's Codex connection") with the authorizing person's avatar, revoked rows disappear, and the copied invitation is shorter ([#15411](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15411)).
- **Sixteen more apps in the catalog** — Gauge ([#15596](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15596)), Superagent ([#15394](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15394)), Telem.AI web search ([#15379](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15379)), Enterpret ([#13906](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13906)), Calendly, Exa, Firecrawl, GSC Wizard, Parallel Search, Tavily, and Windsor.ai ([#15621](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15621)), and Bitly, Context7, Hugging Face, and Resend ([#15686](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15686)) join as verified hosted MCP connections. Sentry sign-in discovers OAuth through its MCP resource metadata, so setup no longer asks for a client ID and secret ([#15837](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15837)), and OAuth grants now record whether each scope came from the provider or from Paperclip's request ([#14059](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14059)).
- **New Runner providers** — OpenAI Dot joins as a standalone experimental agent choice: pair your Dot with a one-use code, and the Runner delivers assignments over MCP Events while Dot uses its own tools and reports back ([#15402](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15402), [#15414](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15414), [#15581](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15581), [#15734](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15734)). Pi 1.0 runs through the experimental Runner with explicit provider and model selection ([#14921](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14921)), and the Cursor Runner integration is consolidated onto mainline recovery behavior with a public install path ([#15075](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15075)).
- **Codex and OpenCode that just start** — Native Codex uses the installed Codex CLI and accepts usable older or newer versions, so a clean npm install no longer needs a global command ([#15555](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15555)); a model that the sandbox's Codex CLI is too old for is swapped for a compatible one with a visible warning instead of failing every turn ([#15399](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15399), [#15519](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15519)); saved runs survive server upgrades ([#15518](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15518)); and task environment variables reach later turns and tool commands ([#15451](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15451)). Native OpenCode streams text as it arrives ([#15708](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15708)), starts without the postinstall script that package managers skip ([#15702](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15702)), and selects the bundled Linux assets for remote runs without path overrides ([#15721](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15721)).
- **Reports you can open on the task** — HTML attachments and workspace `.html` files render in an opaque-origin sandbox with view-source and download controls ([#15447](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15447)), and CSV files open as tables with row numbers, sticky headers, and record counts ([#15445](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15445)).
- **Clearer task provenance and waits** — A follow-up task an agent creates while working on a task now defaults to that task as its parent, and the task page shows "Created from <task> by <agent>" ([#15762](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15762)); native agents can schedule their own one-shot task monitor and yield until it fires ([#15446](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15446)); the monitor card gets an X with a confirmation ([#15735](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15735)); and a saved pull request stays visible in Properties with its review request and a **Check status** action even when the provider lookup fails ([#15375](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15375)).
- **Your primary agent** — Each person gets one primary agent per company, shown with a crown on the roster and used as the fallback for new tasks and Chat when there is no recent choice; the first agent you create becomes primary automatically and can be changed on the agent profile ([#15470](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15470)).
- **Company decision models and fast responses** — Company Settings can bind one shared OpenAI or OpenRouter API connection for small typed model decisions, with permission checks, budget reservations, and a Costs → Decisions history ([#15473](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15473)). On top of it, **Experimental fast responses** posts a short acknowledgement comment within three seconds of a human message while the agent starts its normal run, in tasks, Agent Chat, and Slack and GitHub threads ([#15748](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15748)).

## Fixes

- **Workspaces and sandboxes** — A transient sandbox copy-back failure is retried up to three times before the task is held for repair, and remaining holds explain what happened in plain language ([#15920](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15920)); a remote sandbox whose required copy-back failed is kept, with its files, behind an explicit repair decision instead of being deleted by cleanup ([#15479](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15479), [#15790](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15790)); server shutdown waits for a legacy adapter's workspace export before releasing its sandbox lease ([#15857](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15857)); a reused saved worktree keeps its original repository when project settings change ([#15528](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15528)); an accepted native result is no longer mistaken for lost work by the orphan reaper after a restart ([#15718](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15718)); OpenCode runs in the realized workspace via `--dir` ([#11438](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/11438)); Daytona OpenCode sessions keep their deadlines ([#15905](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15905)); and OpenCode timeouts no longer claim the configured deadline expired ([#15789](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15789)).
- **Runs, recovery, and questions** — A retry no longer burns itself while a stopped run's environment is still cleaning up, and settled repair instructions stop reappearing in later wakes ([#15463](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15463)); a review wait whose automatic repair also leaves no wake path now records a board decision instead of sitting silently ([#15764](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15764)); a parent is woken again when a child finishes requested revisions ([#15372](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15372)); native runs resume cleanly after connection approval decisions with final usage retained ([#15471](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15471), [#15420](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15420), [#15514](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15514)); a pending tool request expires on its own when the user has already connected the service in Apps ([#15856](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15856)); agents stop re-asking questions that moved into feed history ([#15392](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15392)); archiving a task during its completion no longer deadlocks ([#15615](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15615)); and a task policy with a monitor but no stages no longer crashes the task page ([#15593](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15593)).
- **Adapters** — Claude CLI sessions resume across per-run agent file copies ([#15437](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15437)); Hermes gets managed instructions through its system overlay instead of a copy in every resumed user turn ([#15439](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15439)); and external agents such as Dot are told to use their own tools when a Paperclip app is missing ([#15734](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15734)).
- **Connections and MCP** — One oversized or malformed MCP reply fails only that call instead of locking the whole connection in an error state ([#15462](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15462)); remote MCP callbacks keep an explicitly saved empty agent selection, token exchange sends `Accept: application/json`, and saved hidden-provider drafts resume from Finish setup ([#15686](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15686)); Airtable, Calendly, and other verified providers get the registration and form fixes found in live testing ([#15621](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15621)); and the sidebar keeps its last plugin items quiet when the server is unreachable ([#15588](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15588)).

## Improvements

- Hiring, approval, pause, resume, and termination run through a durable agent lifecycle with explicit states: proposed hires stay pending until approval, approved hires are prepared and have their harness configuration verified before work, required plugins get callbacks at each step, and the agent page shows lifecycle progress with a retry action ([#15631](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15631), [#15391](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15391)); plugins can consume a durable resource lifecycle journal with acknowledgments, seeded with a one-time baseline of existing agents and projects, and project archive and restore now write journal events ([#15343](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15343), [#15371](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15371)).
- Every agent gets a persistent Ed25519 keypair, created on hire or on its next managed run, encrypted at rest and handed to managed processes as `PAPERCLIP_AGENT_KEY_ID`, `PAPERCLIP_AGENT_PUBLIC_KEY`, and `PAPERCLIP_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY`; the public key appears on the agent overview ([#15352](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15352)).
- Agents can file complaints and suggestions about their tooling into the instance's `agent_commentary` table through new `complain` and `suggestion-box` skills or native `submit_complaint` and `submit_suggestion` tools, keeping that feedback out of task threads ([#15367](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15367)).
- Idle instances go quiet: chat delivery, provider action, Slack sync, email, Browser Use cleanup, and five server delivery queues now wake from committed writes and known deadlines instead of scanning the database every second or three ([#15625](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15625), [#15750](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15750), [#15757](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15757), [#15802](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15802), [#15808](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15808), [#15822](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15822)); hosts that park idle instances get an idle-sleep safety report that fences accepted work, drains plugin workers, and treats finished logins, consumed retries, and verified delivery history as history rather than pending work ([#15522](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15522), [#15599](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15599), [#15761](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15761), [#15851](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15851), [#15897](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15897), [#15907](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15907)), with an opt-in final backup checkpoint before sleep ([#15629](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15629)).
- Task notifications show the actor's name and avatar and hide your own actions ([#15695](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15695)); other people's comments in task chat appear on the left with their name and avatar, and only yours are on the right in blue ([#15494](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15494)); an agent blocked by an AI connection its responsible user cannot use shows an expanded error naming the agent and connection with a link to its AI settings ([#15741](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15741)); and a teammate without the agent's required personal AI account can connect their own from inside the chat and resume the message ([#15376](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15376)).
- The task composer keeps its model label steady while the effort slider moves and the slider is larger ([#15444](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15444)), nested selectors scroll with the wheel and touch ([#15374](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15374)), the project picker always offers **No project** ([#15382](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15382)), routine descriptions keep code-block pastes in the code block and gain a copy control ([#15773](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15773)), confirmation cards stack the prompt above the target pill and hide unlabeled machine keys ([#15895](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15895)), chat connection and recovery cards share one surface ([#15771](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15771)), the Slack chat-or-tools chooser gets icons ([#15574](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15574)), the Workspace filter leaves the task and inbox filter menus ([#15788](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15788)), and the star and leave buttons leave the agent index ([#15400](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15400)).
- Tasks whose starting branch does not exist in the repository show a branch repair card that offers the remote's default branch or a typed branch and retries through the normal admission gates ([#15726](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15726)); a GitHub reference the instance's credentials cannot see is reported as inaccessible and re-checked instead of frozen as "Not found" ([#15906](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15906)); and the Paperclip skill ships its own issue-update helper and honors a harness checkout instead of demanding a second one ([#15554](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15554), [#15548](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15548)).
- Workspace jobs that exit non-zero return `422 workspace_job_failed` with the job's own output instead of a 500 ([#15941](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15941)); custom source launchers get the native Runner WebSocket transport from the shared HTTP server constructor ([#15682](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15682)); a refused local Hermes Gateway connection explains which host to check ([#15520](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15520)); and pi-local's unavailable-model error no longer dumps the model catalog ([#13628](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13628)).
- Failure reports carry bounded evidence for Daytona acquisition timeouts and provider state, workspace base-ref resolution, sandbox transfer and sync-out errors, orphan process loss, ACP bridge terminal frames, Git worktree inspection, and stackless browser rejections ([#15946](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15946), [#15736](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15736), [#15719](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15719), [#15637](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15637), [#15481](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15481), [#15475](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15475), [#15478](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15478), [#15525](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15525), [#15940](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15940)), while proven configuration blockers such as a missing user secret, an unchosen AI account, a credential not shared with the responsible user, a local-directory project with a worktree policy, or an external service outage stay out of Sentry ([#15472](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15472), [#15618](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15618), [#15714](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15714), [#15521](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15521), [#15590](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15590)).

## Upgrade Guide

- **Migrations `0306`–`0333`** run on upgrade: `0306` allows `google` in the AI account-default provider checks; `0307` rewrites the lifecycle-event action constraint; `0308` adds `agent_identity_keys`; `0309` adds `plugin_lifecycle_acknowledgments`, indexes the lifecycle journal, and seeds a one-time baseline event per existing agent and project; `0310` adds `agent_commentary`; `0311` adds MCP attachment upload and file ticket tables; `0312` adds accounting receipt, reservation, adjustment, invoice, and provider snapshot tables, widens cost columns to `numeric`, and adds the budget unpriced-usage policy (default `block`); `0313` adds `issue_access_grants` and `project_access_members`, adds `visibility` to tasks and projects (default `open`), and backfills privacy parent edges and run bindings in 1,000-row batches; `0314` binds historical inline draft images to their first task; `0315` adds `user_company_preferences` and backfills a primary agent from history; `0316` adds decision model tables; `0317` adds OpenAI Dot binding, mailbox, and assignment tables; `0318` adds `chat_slack_registrations`; `0319` makes Dot agent refresh tokens non-expiring; `0320` adds agent lifecycle columns and derives `lifecycle_state` from each agent's current status; `0321` adds `chat_endpoints.require_at_mention`; `0322` adds AI subscription account and price tables; `0323` adds GitHub registration owner columns; `0324`–`0330` add the experimental voice session tables; `0331` adds fast-response tables and `issue_comments.origin`; `0332` adds a question-history index concurrently; `0333` adds cost data-quality indexes. `0313` and `0314` run outside a single transaction and commit each batch, so an interrupted upgrade leaves them pending and safe to rerun; expect them to take longer on instances with large run histories.
- **New environment variables**, none required: `PAPERCLIP_ISSUE_PRIVACY_MODE` (default `enforce`; `shadow` logs would-deny decisions without enforcing, `off` disables the predicate) ([#10633](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/10633)); `PAPERCLIP_DB_BACKUP_IDLE_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED=1` opts an instance with automatic backups into taking a final verified backup before idle sleep (off by default) ([#15629](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15629)); `PAPERCLIP_RESPONSIBLE_USER_AUTHZ_CACHE_TTL_MS` bounds the responsible-user permission snapshot (default `5000`) ([#10633](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/10633)).
- **New experimental settings**, all off by default: **GitHub review bots** (`enableGitHubReviewBots`) shows GitHub bot setup and management ([#15416](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15416)); **OpenAI Dot** (`enableOpenAiDot`) adds Dot as an agent choice and requires **Assistant connections (MCP)**, authenticated sign-in, and an HTTPS `PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL` ([#15414](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15414)); **Experimental fast responses** (`enableFastResponses`) reveals Company Settings → Connections and allows acknowledgement comments ([#15748](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15748)). Decision model setup lives under Company Settings → General until fast responses are on ([#15473](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15473)).
- **Review Operator members** ([#15377](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15377)): Operators now hold company editing, invitation, connection, tool, and audit grants after startup seeding. Demote members who should not configure agents or connect accounts.
- **Budget policies and unpriced usage** ([#14997](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/14997)): existing policies get `unpricedUsagePolicy: block`. If your agents run on providers whose prices Paperclip cannot determine, set the policy to `allow` or resolve unpriced events through the cost adjustment flow so the budget does not hold them.
- **Custom adapters and managed processes** ([#15352](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15352)): managed runs now receive `PAPERCLIP_AGENT_KEY_ID`, `PAPERCLIP_AGENT_PUBLIC_KEY`, and `PAPERCLIP_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY`; the key values are multiline PEM strings and the private key must not be logged. The wrapping key is `PAPERCLIP_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY` or the local secrets master-key file; a wrong master key fails the run rather than regenerating the keypair.
- **Private-task callers** ([#10633](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/10633)): direct reads of a private task by a non-member return `404`; owners and admins must pass `?breakGlass=true` for an audited emergency read; plugins are non-member principals and see no private content.
- **Slack and GitHub drafts**: existing Slack bot drafts without a saved setup method stay on manual setup ([#15413](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15413)); existing GitHub bots, direct webhooks, and manual existing-App recovery keep working, but their settings are hidden until **GitHub review bots** is enabled ([#15416](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15416)).
- **Harness pins** are unchanged for Codex, Claude, and OpenCode. Native Codex now prefers the Codex CLI installed with the server package and tolerates version drift; a sandbox image whose Codex CLI is too old for the selected model is switched to a compatible model with a warning ([#15555](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15555), [#15519](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15519)).
- No other configuration or API changes require action.

## Contributors

This release has 200 commits from 7 contributors. Thank you to everyone who contributed to this release!

@lorenzozanee, @lusoris

body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.192

Released on 2026-10-24.

H265 and HDR renders work again on machines with more than 16 cores. Cloud renders of long, cut-heavy edits spend far less time probing and reading audio.

## Fixes

- **Engine:** H265 renders no longer fail on hosts with more than 16 cores ([53e1dfce9e6a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/53e1dfce9e6afbf1fcac26ea4adf27a66039b837), [#6193](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6193)).
- **CLI:** A check that hits its deadline keeps the findings it already made ([ebb057fb62f1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ebb057fb62f10e97a2d89f70eab9840394b074cf), [#6190](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6190)).
- **CLI:** Normalize muted targets before applying tolerance ([0b8f5ec8f5ae](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b8f5ec8f5ae600b060910c5139cd125a0194200), [#5291](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5291)).
- **Core:** Release decoded preview audio once no clip uses its source ([09d7f1c64660](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09d7f1c646606c2b6a39b0f98809084814b99917), [#6178](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6178)).
- **Studio Server:** Project history no longer copies video, audio or huge files ([5ebbc8ef6dbf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5ebbc8ef6dbfbdb556d014cff7af0f8cb8985682), [#6171](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6171)).
- **CLI:** Audit clipped text beneath transparent composition hosts ([2a9b9f4e7c2f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a9b9f4e7c2f955bfa181f6ae0e15b484948c673), [#5400](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5400)).
- **CLI:** Refuse undo when a target or backup is missing ([9ab4de459988](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9ab4de459988280e4985e5ca5d0f8df69b93da18), [#5365](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5365)).
- **Lint:** Check timeline registration before explicit font loads ([191caf943ab5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/191caf943ab55bdc56bfbbb4274fe149d095bb3b), [#5363](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5363)).
- **Studio Server:** Decode authored audio attributes for loudness ([0aa728b1aa24](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0aa728b1aa24326b82afa2ffd178ade14dbefa82), [#5289](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5289)).
- **CLI:** Stage temporary HTML comparisons without recursive copies ([bd0be1bdae15](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bd0be1bdae155721308564c34aa89860266a1ece), [#5286](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5286)).
- **Core:** Preserve blocked addresses in mounted import maps ([ecf5db7070c4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ecf5db7070c4445e7c425b35a05c2c6de4b35613), [#5277](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5277)).
- **Lint:** Read actual font CSS declarations ([a1b23f1e4dd2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a1b23f1e4dd2b64e7ca3058052d5f849f7e24383), [#5221](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5221)).
- **CLI:** Fail benchmarks with no completed renders ([9e533f0887cd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9e533f0887cdb17a7d5c1cb6d9034aec39fe9e80), [#5303](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5303)).
- **CLI:** Read info metadata from the root composition ([8a84bedd38b2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8a84bedd38b2c002f379323b8b01251c24e77cb4), [#5299](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5299)).
- **CLI:** Capture images declared only through srcset ([1001a7941983](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1001a79419838b3b93735e6d4eb12ede42d1950d), [#5298](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5298)).
- **Parsers:** Recognize spaced slideshow type attributes ([0a37f9b9bb34](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a37f9b9bb3463b2c3253484d1526da2275220d6), [#5326](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5326)).
- **CLI:** Close asset streams when clients disconnect ([410030a7331b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/410030a7331bd69d1bb318a343d80cda91334a4e), [#5321](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5321)).
- **CLI:** Preserve portrait orientation during background removal ([58752b5cf3e2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/58752b5cf3e2bf3e74d74602b31f15f2a20953be), [#5313](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5313)).
- **CLI:** Tolerate invalid optional package cache manifests ([1e6a2f0ff92f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1e6a2f0ff92f106f77a9b57f85a9ec576b8ced36), [#5349](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5349)).
- **CLI:** Honor HTML attribute casing in frame-rate defaults ([c00a1bc1d427](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c00a1bc1d4278a45bc1bb6c11b45943bd037b18d), [#5348](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5348)).
- **Core:** Preserve literal percent in beat source paths ([234b87a4bbbd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/234b87a4bbbde51100005c7be013f0f052339dde), [#5327](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5327)).
- **CLI:** Preserve stylesheet order during website capture ([ad06c60c7402](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ad06c60c7402cd1db8f74132f655e1382ef81898), [#5311](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5311)).
- **CLI:** Detect beats from child media sources ([e10155ce35b1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e10155ce35b1f698a8e1ca6062f73227b148dca8), [#5310](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5310)).
- **CLI:** Retain metadata when Lottie previews exceed the size limit ([58578fc22974](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/58578fc22974c78eb42f788dc9bac1df3767a78c), [#5307](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5307)).
- **CLI:** Show complete history diffs for large text changes ([ac6c682a0d77](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ac6c682a0d77407f7f74accaba78f6290918217e), [#5305](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5305)).
- **Engine:** Preserve Windows RSS samples after a query failure ([ba5dde78de2e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ba5dde78de2eba4b7f5d5eef7687147d026d5da3), [#5357](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5357)).
- **Engine:** Recognize spaced closing template tags ([cad57bf2aa46](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cad57bf2aa469b34791d787b7604ac8ae9c56938), [#5353](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5353)).
- **Engine:** Retain fresh frames when replacing an empty cache ([6fccefe9761b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6fccefe9761b6094b1b84e60f654ceae5fff664a), [#5351](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5351)).
- **CLI:** Tolerate removed files during desktop catch-up ([e7f6c12b9166](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e7f6c12b9166308bfeed3b14d4949efeba42fa16), [#5350](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5350)).
- **CLI:** Respect image orientation in capture contact sheets ([e0317a23c09a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e0317a23c09a51b6fca615ed69e9a52e5689ef53), [#5295](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5295)).
- **CLI:** Protect batch input from generated manifest ([d94a9d7aabb3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d94a9d7aabb35d02f59ed77a9a0127e54cd265b1), [#5294](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5294)).
- **CLI:** Init never touches installed skills and no command removes one ([0d104e6fca49](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0d104e6fca496f7d8659c9266813fc6750294635), [#6168](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6168)).
- **Studio:** Preserve caption text when parsing transcripts ([886e8696dfc4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/886e8696dfc43d748a221adf51678fc99d4ca74a), [#3896](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3896)).

## Performance

- **Producer:** The audio task finds sound with a probe and reads URL clips in parallel ([acb47de7d298](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/acb47de7d298f2f53818fb30051fdae110e2b5be), [#6174](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6174)).
- **Engine:** A site's remote files are probed once per render, not once per clip ([da3e9b6385ef](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/da3e9b6385ef5b339143f588297d849fbdfa940b), [#6172](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6172)).

## Docs & Examples

- Clarify Claude Code plugin auto-update steps ([fa5dbd12c969](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa5dbd12c969e17619ca1dd6ca9537dd1b992101), [#5120](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5120)).

## Internal

- **Engine:** The GPU probe tests do not start a Chrome from the host cache ([3ef28e26c6f4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3ef28e26c6f44a7ff34da744670b8d6ccd699106), [#6187](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6187)).
- **Core:** Isolate local font fallback from system discovery ([14c9eb448751](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/14c9eb44875100b4bf4298b6df47a13ea7f80316), [#5360](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5360)).
- Use supported FFmpeg flags for VFR fixtures ([bd4d8c6cb5bc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bd4d8c6cb5bc2de88fb57193bce802a4a87dc523), [#5352](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5352)).

name: v0.8.191
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.191

Released on 2026-10-24.

A deleted layer that a script still looks up now stays hidden instead of coming back, and a script that throws no longer blocks a render. Preview loads only the clips due next, so it holds up on slow links.

## Features

- **Studio:** Motion blur panel with Off / Subtle / Strong ([ffc327b44](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ffc327b44c548576bb40be2eef14bc04d7694d6f), [#6112](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6112)).
- **CLI:** Check writes a progress line to stderr per sample, overlap batch and craft frame ([55cbc0e15](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/55cbc0e158b38e25cc240f9b45d13f69c498a823), [#6151](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6151)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Exclude rendering flags from tween tail warnings ([84e6dfd24](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84e6dfd2477db4d54056459b6d4202ee10824402), [#5711](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5711)).
- **Engine:** Redraw a small drawElement frame before failing the serial capture ([c478110be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c478110be79c0c3fe60237ec42d1389fa9771bca), [#5748](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5748)).
- **Core:** Preview fetches only the clips due next, and drops passed clips still downloading ([179098936](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/179098936faaa21fd2bf74dfa80b4e705fdb3c65), [#6160](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6160)).
- **Core:** A hidden child of a mover stays out of the blur trail ([e077d9dc7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e077d9dc7468ebaa63d2985977ae7da525446086), [#6155](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6155)).
- **Sdk:** A kept delete drops its media sources and a hidden video is not waited for ([44100a537](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/44100a53702e474687f1c68e23e31b995c7c8c12), [#6163](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6163)).
- **Studio:** Audio clips in the timeline share the video clip corner radius ([579f73bf2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/579f73bf29df3f4b4f5d0d6f95f1d3bd47869ede), [#6159](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6159)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot waits for the image layers a seek reveals before capturing ([1552f52fb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1552f52fbe9313f9323f08c4401e83ea11857ec9), [#6161](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6161)).
- **Engine:** A composition whose script throws is skipped with a warning, not refused ([8df9b6dd3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8df9b6dd3b3720308ac42cda6158454f55d9bcee), [#6156](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6156)).
- **Sdk:** A stored delete a script still looks up is hidden when overrides replay, not removed ([dad825945](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dad8259457ca8fbf40a5f6d3910da7a88cfa0773), [#6143](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6143)).

## Performance

- **AWS Lambda:** A render reads a video's audio from a small file stored beside it ([3439433d6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3439433d676f8440272621f9a1a453aa9b123294), [#6162](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6162)).

## Docs & Examples

- **CLI:** Apply review notes from #5442 to open, timeline and history ([fb8aadad1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fb8aadad1713309be1ba8c2e3d65d37e892b2af4), [#6110](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6110)).
- **Skills:** Remove duplicated sections in skill references ([d5526bd48](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d5526bd48025890d39c1a1a8f7eb6823a1277b86), [#6164](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6164)).

## Internal

- **Engine:** Only h264 is held to identical bytes across host sizes ([19cc96e3f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/19cc96e3f29337cfe1ed655121c8c48d8b310f86), [#6167](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6167)).

name: v0.8.190
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.190

Released on 2026-10-23.

Motion blur now picks a cheaper way to draw when it can, and renders use less memory. Studio gains a preview seek bar, and an idle editor stops waking the GPU.

## Features

- Automatic tier, 240°/32 defaults, check finding, and Studio stops opting out ([79b57ab12](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/79b57ab12dfdd4e84536af7f227401f6fac24a60), [#6108](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6108)).
- **Core:** Capture blur falls back to per-element filters where capture cannot run ([4ed781338](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4ed78133873540ca10366b1230d973dc31ae2ddf), [#6107](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6107)).
- **Studio:** Add a preview seek bar ([2512642d0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2512642d09d3d5a4703fd2e6af71930a52e6c7ca), [#6103](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6103)).

## Fixes

- **Engine:** The BeginFrame start-up check waits for the first frame up to its deadline ([73718a251](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73718a251bbbd4a8a4f649f4fc007e3a726015c5), [#6149](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6149)).
- **Engine:** A render no longer decodes the videos it replaces with extracted frames ([01a523bcf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01a523bcf8d0cd827359ed35b28d9f0be0ad011e), [#6142](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6142)).
- **CLI:** Render -c takes an absolute entry inside the project, relative to the project ([9fe0511c2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9fe0511c2e10b3dddafe80393dfb618bd424072d), [#6141](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6141)).
- **Engine:** The video frame cache budget is shared by the capture workers ([f8ae1483c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f8ae1483c580fd4f5691f83f6c3cf93d20e3227e), [#6135](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6135)).
- **Studio:** The thumbnail capture page loads media near the playhead like the preview ([28ac4d76b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/28ac4d76b6af9c13c9a877fc2472207cc577a4d3), [#6146](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6146)).
- **Engine:** A long audio mix prepares its clips a few at a time ([1dc97921c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1dc97921cd0713ace6a579e861f0b967210509b8), [#6132](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6132)).

## Performance

- **Studio:** An idle editor stops waking the GPU four times a second ([6ad7c82d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6ad7c82d2175d018a93a85e96883dc31231b9884), [#6109](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6109)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Warm the audio function while the plan runs ([fb2f7c1a8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fb2f7c1a80eb06fa8d063340f2e6dbbb8dfc6ac1), [#6148](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6148)).

## Full changelog
